data: NVIDIA's revenue rose from $26,974 million in fiscal 2023 (ended January 29, 2023) to $130,497 million in fiscal 2025 (ended January 26, 2025), according to the consolidated statements of income in its fiscal 2025 Form 10-K. That is an increase of $103,523 million, or about 383.8%, meaning fiscal 2025 revenue was roughly 4.84 times the fiscal 2023 level. Revenue for fiscal 2024, the year in between, was $60,922 million.
